paragraphs: A Land Rover TDV6 SDV6 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to — the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most TDV6 SDV6 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six TDV6 SDV6-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover TDV6/SDV6 engine?
faqLeft.a: The TDV6 and SDV6 are 3.0-litre V6 diesel engines, part of the Ford Lion V6 family, developed jointly by Ford and Land Rover. They were produced from 2004 to 2019 and fitted across three Land Rover model lines.

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the TDV6/SDV6?
faqLeft.a: Discovery (L319 D3/D4), Range Rover (L322/L405), and Range Rover Sport (L320/L494).

faqLeft.q: What's the difference between TDV6 and SDV6?
faqLeft.a: The TDV6 uses a single turbocharger with lower power output (211-258 PS), while the SDV6 uses twin turbochargers with higher power output (292-306 PS). Both share the same engine block and key components.

faqLeft.q: Is a TDV6 engine compatible with an SDV6?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically — TDV6 vs SDV6 variants differ significantly (single vs twin turbo, different power outputs). Registration/VIN matching is required.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover TDV6/SDV6 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,400. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on TDV6/SDV6 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqRight.q: What are the common issues with the TDV6/SDV6?
faqRight.a: Crankshaft failure (snapped crankshaft) is the most feared failure on this engine. Crankshaft bearing rotation/failure, timing chain tensioner failure, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and turbocharger failures (particularly secondary turbo faults on SDV6) are confirmed issues.

faqRight.q: What does cold-start chain rattle indicate?
faqRight.a: Cold-start chain rattle that clears after 10 to 15 seconds is not normal and indicates timing chain tensioner wear requiring attention.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a TDV6/SDV6 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most TDV6/SDV6 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the known crankshaft and timing chain issues on this engine family — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
